title: The Cheapest Places to Buy a House in San Antonio Right Now (2026)
seo_title: Cheapest Places to Buy a House in San Antonio (2026) | Kanye Concierge 360
description: The most affordable San Antonio ZIP codes and suburbs in 2026, from under $150,000 to $350,000, with typical home values, what to check before you buy, and down payment help.
keywords: cheapest places to buy a house in San Antonio
first time home buyer San Antonio
hero_alt: Buying an affordable home in San Antonio
intro: San Antonio is still one of the most affordable big cities in Texas. The typical home in the City of San Antonio is worth about $247,000, and prices have dipped over the past year.
Here is where your money goes furthest right now, from under $150,000 to the $350,000 suburbs. Every number is listed so you can compare at a glance.

sections.h2: Under $150,000: the lowest prices in the city
after: Expect older homes in these ZIP codes. Many are solid, but budget for repairs and never skip the inspection.
Typical home values are the Zillow Home Value Index for August 2026, not sale prices. A specific home can sell well above or below its area's typical value.

sections.h2: Why buyers have more room to negotiate right now
items: Metro median sale price (Sept 2026): $302,999, down about 2% from a year ago
Average days on market: 88, up 11% from a year ago
Homes sold for: 92.4% of their original list price, on average
after: More homes for sale and longer days on market mean sellers are more willing to deal. That can mean a lower price, help with closing costs, or repairs paid by the seller.

sections.h2: Before you buy a cheap house, check these
items: Flood risk: read the seller's disclosure. The Texas form asks about the 100-year and 500-year floodplain and past flooding
Inspection: always get one, especially on older homes
Property taxes: roughly 2.27% to 2.44% of value a year inside San Antonio before exemptions, depending on the school district
Homestead exemption: file it after you move in. It takes $140,000 off your home's value for school taxes
Down payment help: the City of San Antonio's HIP 80 offers up to $30,000 on existing homes priced up to $260,000, if you qualify by income

faq.q: What is the cheapest area to buy a house in San Antonio?
faq.a: By typical home value in August 2026, ZIP code 78207 on the Westside is the lowest at about $109,500, followed by 78225 and 78237.

faq.q: How much is a typical house in San Antonio?
faq.a: The typical home in the City of San Antonio was worth about $247,000 in August 2026 (Zillow Home Value Index). The metro median sale price was $302,999 in September 2026 (SABOR).

faq.q: Can I get help with a down payment in San Antonio?
faq.a: Yes, if you qualify. The City of San Antonio's HIP program, TDHCA's My First Texas Home and TSAHC's programs all offer down payment help with income and price limits. See our first-time buyer guide.
